checks: Original synthesis with source-level attribution; no copied source figures or transcripts.
Pharmaceutical incompatibility, PK and PD separated; interaction distinct from adverse event.
AUC and peak, free fraction and free concentration separated; linear-kinetic assumptions stated.
Substrate, inhibitor and inducer distinct; persistence and parallel pathways included.
Gut efflux, hepatic uptake and composite renal secretion isolated; local and plasma exposure distinguished.
CIPRO oral chelation and Edurant UK tablet pH interaction retain formulation context.
CDC combined-contraception distinction and FDA grapefruit counterexample replace historical generalizations.
Cobicistat CYP3A mechanism reconciled with EMA; unrelated antiviral claims excluded.
Three previously published ozanimod texts retained without new clinical-review claim.
No patient-specific dose calculations or complete-book/course claim.
limits: Single integrator editorial review, not independent clinical validation.
Source figures not listed remain unchecked; official sources read only in selected passages.
Browser and publication verification recorded separately.

publicLabelUpdate.scope: Denominazioni dei materiali del corso rese generiche; contenuti scientifici, intervalli di lettura e limiti conservati. Non è una nuova revisione clinica.
